question:
A teacher wants to **design** a demonstration tank of total depth $30\,\text{cm}$ (measured from the top free surface to the bottom). The bottom part of the tank is filled with a **plane glass block** of thickness $t$ (refractive index $n_g=1.5$), and the remaining height $(30-t)$ is filled with water (refractive index $n_w=\dfrac{4}{3}$). A mark is made on the **bottom face** of the glass block.

When the mark is viewed **normally from air** from above the water surface, its apparent depth from the top water surface is required to be exactly $22\,\text{cm}$.
